{{Quote|My legs aren't moving, I must need maintenance.|The droid upon entering battle|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
A '''B1 battle droid''' in the [[Geonosian droid army]] served in the [[Petranaki Arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. The [[battle droid]] had its head grafted onto the chassis of [[C-3PO]] when the [[protocol droid]] had gotten trapped in the droid factory's conveyor belt system. Meanwhile, C-3PO's own head was grafted onto a B1 battle droid chassis.<ref name="Episode II" />

During the ensuing battle, both the B1 droid and C-3PO engaged in battle with various [[Jedi]]. The battle droid remarked on its inability to move as fast as its other B1 allies, but surmised it as a maintenance issue. Later in the battle, the droid fired on a lone [[human]] Jedi, who deflected the blaster fire back at it, resulting in its decapitation. Following the battle, [[R2-D2]] reattached C-3PO's head to his original body.<ref name="Episode II" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified battle droid was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]<ref name="20 Years Attack of the Clones">{{SWYouTube|cN3xxVrOxbM|Star Wars: Attack of the Clones 20th Anniversary Celebration | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim 2022}}</ref> in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
